declaration.preface: At Val Organics Private Limited, we are dedicated to fostering a work environment that prioritizes the well-being of our employees. Our commitment to fair and equitable compensation practices forms the cornerstone of our Living Wage Policy. This policy aims to ensure that every employee receives compensation that not only meets their basic needs but also enables them to achieve a decent standard of living.
declaration.declaration: Val Organics Private Limited is steadfast in its commitment to providing fair and equitable compensation to all employees, aligning with our core values of integrity and compassion. We will regularly assess and adjust living wage rates in accordance with prevailing standards and market conditions, ensuring that our employees can sustain themselves and their families while contributing meaningfully to our organization's success.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all Val Organics Private Limited locations and extends to all employees, contractors, suppliers, partners, and stakeholders associated directly or indirectly with the company.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
This policy aims to ensure that every employee receives compensation that not only meets their basic needs but also enables them to achieve a decent standard of living.

Val Organics Pvt. Ltd. is committed to ensuring that employee compensation supports a decent standard of living and aligns with applicable living wage principles.

Data Collection and Assessment: Collect and analyze relevant wage, cost-of-living, inflation, statutory wage, and economic data from reliable sources to assess wage adequacy and identify potential gaps between current wages and living wage benchmarks.

Living Wage Benchmarking: Compare employee compensation levels against recognized living wage benchmarks, industry standards, regional wage data, and legal minimum wage requirements to evaluate competitiveness and adequacy.

Gap Analysis: Conduct periodic assessments to identify any gaps between current compensation practices and living wage benchmarks, considering factors such as employee categories, geographic locations, and workforce demographics.

Performance Evaluation: Review compensation performance using relevant indicators such as wage levels, employee retention, employee satisfaction, workforce stability, and compliance with legal and organizational requirements.

Continuous Monitoring and Review: Monitor wage practices regularly and conduct annual reviews to evaluate progress, ensure ongoing alignment with living wage principles, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

The policy applies to all Val Organics Private Limited locations and extends to all employees, contractors, suppliers, partners, and stakeholders associated directly or indirectly with the company.

We believe in compensating employees fairly for their contributions, recognizing their intrinsic value to the company.

Acknowledging regional variations in the cost of living, we will adjust wages to ensure that all employees can afford essential necessities.

We will conduct regular reviews of industry benchmarks to remain competitive and uphold fair wage standards.

Employees will be provided with clear and transparent information about how their wages are determined and the factors influencing their compensation.

Enhanced Quality of Life: Our aim is to elevate the overall well-being of employees by providing them with adequate income to sustain a decent standard of living, encompassing essential needs such as healthcare, nutrition, and housing.
Equality and Justice: We are committed to reducing income inequality and ensuring equal pay for equal work, thereby fostering a more just and equitable society.
Compliance and Enforcement: We will establish robust mechanisms to monitor compliance with the living wage policy, enforcing it rigorously to safeguard against exploitation and uphold fair labor standards.
Collaboration: We will engage in collaborative efforts with relevant stakeholders to develop and implement the living wage policy in a manner that reflects diverse perspectives and interests.
Wage Equity: Through our Wage Equity Initiative, we aim to narrow the wage gap with respect to local wage standards, promoting fairness and equity across all levels of our workforce.
Employee Engagement and Consultation: We will engage employees and relevant stakeholders through regular consultations and feedback mechanisms to understand wage-related concerns and continuously improve living wage practices.
Continuous Wage Assessment: We are committed to periodically assessing wage adequacy against recognized living wage benchmarks to ensure compensation remains aligned with changing economic conditions and employee needs.

targets.target: Ensure that 100% of employees receive wages equal to or above the established living wage benchmark
Maintain zero substantiated complaints related to living wage non-compliance
Conduct living wage assessments at least twice annually
Achieve 100% employee awareness of the Living Wage Policy through annual communication and training programs
Integrate cost-of-living considerations into 100% of compensation review processes

responsibilities.duty: Offer strategic guidance and oversight for the effective execution of the living wage policy, ensuring it resonates with the company's ethos and objectives.

Regularly evaluate living wage benchmarks, conduct periodic wage assessments, review and update compensation structures as necessary, address employee wage-related concerns, monitor compliance with the Living Wage Policy, and review and update the Policy annually or as required to reflect changes in legal requirements, economic conditions, and organizational needs.

Strategically allocate financial resources to support the policy's implementation, manage fiscal aspects linked to wage adjustments, and uphold compliance with financial reporting and auditing protocols.
Guarantee adherence to labor laws and regulations, furnishing expertise on legal obligations and requirements to ensure alignment with statutory provisions.
Advocate for equitable remuneration, actively monitor adherence to the policy, and voice any wage-related grievances or suggestions for improvement.
Collaborate with governmental bodies, labor unions, advocacy groups, and suppliers to foster the successful implementation of the policy and contribute to broader societal and economic goals.
Systematically track the advancement of policy implementation, assess its impact on employee welfare and income parity, and pinpoint areas necessitating refinement or enhancement.

policy.monitoring:
Val Organics Pvt. Ltd. shall monitor and review living wage performance on an annual basis.

Living wage-related information shall be reported through internal management reviews, HR reports, and sustainability or ESG disclosures, where applicable.

Reports shall be prepared in a clear and accessible format to support effective decision-making and stakeholder communication.

The reporting process may include monitoring of the following indicators:

Percentage of employees receiving wages at or above the established living wage benchmark.

Living wage gap identified and addressed during the reporting period.

Employee retention and workforce stability indicators.

Employee satisfaction and well-being metrics related to compensation and benefits.

Number of wage-related grievances received and resolved.

Compliance with applicable wage and labor regulations.

The reporting process shall utilize information obtained from:

Payroll and compensation records.

Living wage assessments and gap analysis reports.

Employee surveys, feedback mechanisms, and grievance records.

Internal audits and management reviews.

Human Resources records and workforce performance data.

Applicable legal and regulatory compliance documentation.

Recognized living wage benchmark data and industry references.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Human Resources Manager shall review the Living Wage Policy at least annually, or more frequently if significant changes occur in wage regulations, economic conditions, inflation rates, business operations, workforce composition, or stakeholder expectations.

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including employees, management representatives, worker representatives, and other relevant parties, shall be considered during the review process.

The implementation of the Policy and progress toward achieving established living wage objectives and commitments shall be evaluated to identify areas for improvement.

Wage assessments, living wage benchmark data, employee feedback, compensation trends, workforce retention indicators, and other relevant metrics shall be reviewed against defined objectives and industry best practices.

The effectiveness of actions taken to address identified wage gaps and improve employee well-being shall be assessed as part of the review process.

Based on the review findings, necessary updates, corrective actions, and enhancements shall be recommended to strengthen the effectiveness of the Policy and align with evolving labor standards, living wage methodologies, and stakeholder expectations.

Any revisions to the Policy shall be subject to approval by the CEO of Val Organics Pvt. Ltd., demonstrating leadership commitment to fair compensation and responsible employment practices.

The outcomes of the review process and significant policy updates shall be communicated to relevant stakeholders, as appropriate.

This review mechanism will ensure that Val Organics Pvt. Ltd.'s Living Wage Policy remains relevant, effective, and aligned with its commitment to fair compensation, employee well-being, responsible business practices, and continuous improvement.
